summary: Family investment caster (160 staff, EUR 24.1 M); we are 3.3 % of its turnover, spend up 37 %. Owner expects partnership for the 2022 favour. Its prices are far above our co-sources: HI 80-250 at 654.52 vs 559.61 at 70170 (+17 %), Impeller HI 250 at 118.73 vs 79.44 at 70160 and 40 % over a should-cost not modelled on its plant. We own the tooling. Historically gives way fully (kept share -5.4). Open deep with rival prices.
notes: Needs recognition of its 2022 hold-price favour; otherwise no stated need. Fears losing 75 % / 60 % quotas to 70170 and 70160. Delivery weak: OTD 73 %, amber Q3. Few documents, so traits beyond reciprocity are uncertain.

evidence.quote: in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

arguments: should-cost: HI 250 ~85 vs 118.73 (estimate not of its plant)
delivery scorecard: OTD 73 % vs 95 % target, amber Q3
avoid: changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Open deep on HI 250: co-source 70160 sells it at 79.44, 33 % below.
Use the 70170 price on HI 80-250 as a rival quote, one argument per round.
Thank it for 2022, then say partnership means market prices for both sides.
Offer more quota or binding volume only for a visible price step.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; past renewals settled well below its asks (kept share -5.4), so expect it to move readily.
